Annotators inspected 30 sequences of images generated with different methods and selected the 3 best sequences, out of a total of 5 sequences. They could also indicate 'No good sequence'. In another task, they compared two sequences side-by-side and selected the preferred one or indicated a tie. Finally, they rated sequences on a 5-point Likert scale.
